name: Brown Quail 45
author: Praashoo7
description: Outlined rounded black button that lifts on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, letter-spacing becomes 0.5em, transform becomes translateY(-0.8em), background changes to #171717.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Brown Quail 45</title>
<style>
/* Brown Quail 45 by Praashoo7 — https://uiverse.io/Praashoo7/brown-quail-45 */
button {
  padding: 1em;
  padding-left: 2em;
  padding-right: 2em;
  border-radius: 15px;
  font-weight: bold;
  transition: .4s ease-in-out;
  box-shadow: inset 2px 5px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  border: none;
}

button:hover {
  letter-spacing: 0.5em;
  transform: translateY(-0.8em);
  background: #171717;
  color: white;
}

button:active {
  letter-spacing: 0.4em;
  transition: 0.1s all;
  transform: translateY(-0.6em);
  background: #171717;
  color: white;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
  BUTTON
</button>

</body>
</html>
